scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @rpg-cr/api" "npm run dev -w @rpg-cr/web"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run dev:kill && npm run clean:cache && npm run dev
scripts.clean:cache: npm run clean -w @rpg-cr/web && rm -rf node_modules/.cache apps/web/node_modules/.cache
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rpg-cr/shared && npm run build -w @rpg-cr/api && npm run build -w @rpg-cr/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start -w @rpg-cr/api" "npm run start -w @rpg-cr/web"
scripts.dev:kill: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:4000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; true
